_howto: DERPMAX programme. To add a film: copy an H.264 .mp4 (480p-720p, under 40 MB) into cinema/, add one object to "films" below, reload. See build/cinema/HOWTO_ADD_FILM.md. Nothing is loaded until a player sits down in the auditorium.

films.title: THE DOORS

_fields.title: poster + board title (caps look best)
_fields.file: path from the game folder, H.264 mp4
_fields.runtime: seconds, only for the board (the real length comes from the file)
_fields.days: [first, last] game day it is showing
_fields.poster: {motif: doors|valley|snowball|laser|meteor|slot|town|witch|stars, a: main colour, b: dark colour}
_fields.score: optional {file, loop}: music/sound played with a silent film
